hypothesis: Original third-party specification-only YAML fixture PRs can induce source-bound executable test programs for independently maintained native Go YAML parsers without PR-author-supplied code tests and without manually specifying target-specific test names or case values.
prior_method_boundary: Previous Go AST method scopes only original Go _test.go declarations and global Go test tables, so these fixture-only .yaml inputs constitute a new generator-language obstruction. Old method must explicitly return UNKNOWN_UNSUPPORTED_GO_TEST_PATH when given fixture.
initial_falsifiers: No source path or field-value targets hard-coded into emitter; protocol only supplies source file/commit/blob and publisher documented schema
Original Go selector rejects non-Go fixtures rather than fabricated success
Original fixture Git blobs, schema markdown and Go module source blobs pin before execution
Upstream fixture cases must produce an actual decoded JSON test oracle; case-specific expected result not hand provided
Native generated Go files are independently compiled and run in each untouched publisher repository under temporary test-only copies
A changed oracle produces a real FAIL on a known-positive control and source byte corruption rejects prior to native execution
Fail closed if a parser cannot process the input or matches a different semantic type; do not force all green or declare parser buggy solely from a spec test mismatch
No human-written per-PR code or generated repair claimed. The program generating the program will be human-written after this freeze
The only true software/semantic promotion available is bounded original-source-to-native executable test-construction and conditional observed parser behavior
Autonomous invention or rewriting of generator grammar and full E2E-L7 remain UNKNOWN
baseline: Independent PyYAML safe_load as a third-party parsing oracle compared with original JSON expectation, and conventional go test full suites. Do not claim statistically significant net lifecycle advantage.
